meta.description: Switch Philips Hue lights and set their brightness room by room, using the room groups of the Hue bridge. A package adds a light per room that shows it as on only while one of its bulbs is reachable and on, so a room whose bulbs lost power at the wall switch reads off, plus a count of the bulbs that are on and the lowest battery of the Hue accessories.

hue-bridge.description: The hub that connects Hue bulbs and accessories over Zigbee and puts them on the home network.
hue-bridge.does: Groups the bulbs into rooms. Home Assistant pairs with it by a press on the bridge's button and then controls the rooms and bulbs over the home network.

status.title: Light status
status.description: Report available light or group state and brightness, with coverage limits.

explain.title: About lights
explain.description: Lights report states and brightness; unavailable bulbs are not confirmed off.

turn_on.title: Turn on the light
turn_on.description: Request explicit on for a mapped light; access requires a separate write grant.

turn_off.title: Turn off the light
turn_off.description: Request explicit off for a mapped light; access requires a separate write grant.
